selectionPolicy.primary: independently curated advanced-Japanese relevance and JLPT N1 item-type suitability
selectionPolicy.secondary: licensed dictionary identity, reading, Korean meaning, and natural project-authored examples
exclude: basic or broadly elementary vocabulary unless needed for an N1 contrast/usage question
selectionPolicy.priorityNote: Official JLPT does not publish complete per-word frequency data. This is a transparent N1 study priority, not a claimed official probability.

candidateSelectionCheckpoint.note: The 280 rows are a review queue only. Do not delete or replace existing daily data until each row has a verified reading, Korean meaning, usage/example, N1 suitability reason, and question-quality check.

activeBatchCheckpoint.note: The sixth batch excludes all 1,400 earlier word+reading identities. Its selection adds a stricter holdout for dated/nonstandard spellings, greetings, elementary counters and body/nature words, and low-value everyday loanwords after the strongest five batches exhausted the top of the original pool. It contains exactly 20 words and 15 linked vocabulary MCQs per day. Required fields, unique identities, answer/options, and date links passed. Grammar, reading, final semantic review, 90-day cross-batch reuse validation, and bounded migration generation remain pending.
